verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Mem0 extracts individual facts from raw conversation automatically (mem0-docs-26) and auto-builds a graph linking entities across memories without manual curation (mem0-docs-8, mem0-docs-44), plus MCP tools letting an agent decide what to save (mem0-docs-2). However, there's no explicit documentation of an ongoing background consolidation/deduplication process, and independent community feedback (mem0-comm-9) characterizes it as basic key-value fact storage that 'doesn't learn patterns,' tempering the 'decides for itself' framing. Missing for 10: explicit background/async consolidation mechanics, evidence of pattern-learning or memory merging over time, and independent verification of extraction quality beyond vendor docs.
